DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご注文を伺いましょうか。

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 辛い物が苦手なので唐辛子を抜けるか聞きたいです。それと、卵のアレルギーがあります。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 辛味を抜く希望と卵アレルギーを別々に伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-02.translation: I don't like spicy food, so I'd like to ask whether you can leave out the chili. Also, I have an egg allergy.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: State your request to remove spiciness and your egg allergy separately in Japanese.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 辛さの希望と、アレルギーは分けて確認します。卵を避ける必要があるのですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll check spice preferences separately from allergies. You need to avoid egg, correct?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。辛さは好みですが、卵は少しでも気になります。辛味を抜くだけで卵もなくなると思ってはいません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 好みの辛さと少量の卵を避ける必要を区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. Spiciness is a preference, but even a little egg concerns me. I don't think removing chili also removes egg.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Distinguish in Japanese your spice preference from the need to avoid even small amounts of egg.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 具材や調理について、厨房へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-05.translation: I'll check ingredients and preparation with the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: お願いします。見える卵だけでなく、麺やスープに使われているかも確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 見える具だけでなく麺とスープの使用も確認してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-06.translation: Please. Check not only visible egg toppings but also whether egg is used in the noodles or soup.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to check egg use in noodles and soup as well as visible toppings.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 確認が取れるまで、まだ注文は確定しません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-07.translation: We won't finalize the order until we have confirmation.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 分かりました。卵について対応できないなら、この料理を頼まず、別の選択肢があるか聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 対応不可なら注文せず別の料理の可否を尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-08.translation: Understood. If you can't accommodate the egg allergy, I won't order this dish and will ask whether there are other options.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not order if the allergy cannot be accommodated and will ask about another dish.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 別の料理も、内容を確認してからご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll explain other dishes after checking their contents too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 辛さを変えられることだけで安全だとは判断せず、卵への対応の説明を聞いてから選びます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 辛さ変更だけで安全と決めずアレルギー対応を聞いて選ぶと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't judge it safe only because you can change the spiciness. I'll choose after hearing how the egg allergy can be handled.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will choose after hearing allergy arrangements rather than assume a spice change makes it safe.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。二つのご希望を区別して厨房へ伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-11-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. I'll convey the two requests separately to the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お会計の前に、内容をご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please check the details before paying.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: この焼き魚は売切れと言われて、取消しをお願いしました。まだ一覧にあるので確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 売切れで取消依頼した料理が会計一覧に残っていると申し出る。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was told this grilled fish was sold out and asked to cancel it. It's still on the list, so I'd like it checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that a sold-out dish you requested cancelled remains on the payment list.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 取消しをお申し出になった後、代わりのお料理は注文されましたか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-03.translation: After requesting cancellation, did you order another dish instead?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。鶏肉の料理に替えました。それは届いて食べましたが、焼き魚は届いていません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 代替料理は提供済みで元の料理は未提供だと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes. I switched to a chicken dish. That arrived and I ate it, but the grilled fish never arrived.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that the replacement dish was served but the original was not.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 注文と提供の記録を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check the ordering and serving records.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 二つとも食べたとして払うのではなく、変更の記録を見てから会計をお願いしたいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 変更記録を確認してから支払いたいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-06.translation: Rather than pay as if I ate both, I'd like checkout handled after you check the change record.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to pay after the change record has been checked.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 少しお待ちください。ほかに気になる項目はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please wait a moment. Is there any other item that concerns you?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 飲み物二杯は合っています。魚の一項目だけが、取消しの依頼と違っています。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 正しい飲物項目と問題の一項目を限定する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-08.translation: The two drinks are correct. Only that one fish item differs from my cancellation request.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify in Japanese the correct drink entries and limit the problem to one item.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: その項目を担当へ確認し、改めて一覧をご提示します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check that item with the person responsible and present the list again.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 修正後の一覧で、鶏肉と飲み物が残り、魚の扱いが分かってから合計を確認して払います。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 訂正後の品目と合計を確認して払うと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-10.translation: On the revised list, I'll check that the chicken and drinks remain, understand how the fish is handled, then check the total and pay.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will pay after checking the corrected items and total.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。まず変更の経緯を調べてから、会計内容をご説明します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-12-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. First we'll investigate the change history, then explain the bill.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 料理の変更についてお尋ねですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you asking about changing a dish?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。きのこを抜いて、別のお皿にもらえますか。私は食べず、友人が食べます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 苦手な具を抜いて友人用に別皿でもらえるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. Could you leave out the mushrooms and give them on another plate? I won't eat them, but my friend will.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether an ingredient you dislike can be removed and served separately for your friend.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: きのこを使わない料理にするのか、分けてお出しするのか、確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-03.translation: Let's clarify whether you want a dish without mushrooms or mushrooms served separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 友人の分として別に欲しいです。料理から取り除けば、そのまま別皿で出ると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 使わないことと別に提供することを混同したと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-04.translation: I'd like them separately for my friend. I thought removing them from the dish would mean they would simply come on another plate.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you confused not using an ingredient with serving it separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 調理方法によって対応が異なるので、厨房へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-05.translation: What we can do depends on preparation, so I'll ask the kitchen.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 難しければ友人が別の料理を頼みます。私の皿から食卓で取り分けるつもりではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 不可なら友人が別注文し食卓で取り分けない意向を話す。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-06.translation: If that's difficult, my friend will order another dish. We don't intend to divide them from my plate at the table.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that if unavailable your friend will order separately, and you do not intend to separate the ingredient at the table.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: アレルギーではなく、苦手な食材というご希望でよろしいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-07.translation: Is this a disliked ingredient preference rather than an allergy?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: はい、好みです。私の料理には入れない希望と、友人の分を別に頼めるかの二点です。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: アレルギーではなく好みと伝え二つの希望を整理する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-08.translation: Yes, a preference. There are two requests: not putting them in my dish, and asking whether we can order a separate portion for my friend.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that it is preference, not allergy, and organize the two requests.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 二点を厨房へ伝えます。追加料金も確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll convey both to the kitchen and check additional charges too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。友人にも料金と対応を伝え、二人で確認してから注文を決めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 追加料金と対応を友人と確認してから注文すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-10.translation: Thank you. I'll tell my friend the charge and arrangements, and we'll confirm together before deciding the order.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will check additional charges and arrangements with your friend before ordering.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。具材の扱いと、別注文の可否を確かめてご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-13-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check how the ingredient is handled and whether a separate order is possible, then explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: こちらが御朱印帳です。お受け取りください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-01.translation: Here is your goshuin seal book. Please take it.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。すぐ閉じて、このビニール袋へ入れても大丈夫ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 受取直後に帳を閉じ袋へ入れてよいか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-02.translation: Thank you. Is it all right to close it immediately and put it in this plastic bag?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may close the book and bag it immediately after collection.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 書いた部分がまだ乾いていないので、お渡しした紙の扱いをご確認ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-03.translation: The writing hasn't dried yet, so please check how to use the sheet we provided.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: この紙は御朱印の一部だと思って貼ろうとしました。挟むための物ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 挟まれた紙を貼る物と思ったと説明し役割を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-04.translation: I thought this paper was part of the seal and was going to paste it in. Is it for inserting between pages?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you thought the inserted sheet was for pasting and ask its purpose.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この場面では、写りを避けるために挟んでいます。貼り付ける物ではありません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-05.translation: Here, it is inserted to prevent ink transfer. It isn't meant to be pasted.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 貼らずに挟んで持ちます。乾くまで強く閉じたり、上に重い物を置いたりしない方がよいですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 貼らずに挟み圧力や重い荷物を避けると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'll keep it inserted without pasting. Until it dries, I shouldn't close it tightly or put heavy things on top, correct?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will keep the sheet inserted without pasting and avoid pressure or heavy luggage.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: はい。持ち運ぶ間も、書いた所をこすらないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-07.translation: Yes. While carrying it too, please avoid rubbing the written area.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 今から雨の外へ出るので、袋へ入れる時も押しつぶさず持ちたいです。乾いた後の紙は外してよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 雨の移動時の保持と乾燥後に紙を外せるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'm about to go outside in the rain, so I'd like to carry it without crushing it when putting it in the bag. May I remove the paper after it dries?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about carrying it in the rain and removing the paper after drying.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 状態を見て、紙を外す際も書いた部分に触れないようにしてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-09.translation: Check its condition, and when removing the sheet, avoid touching the writing too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 分かりました。今は挟んだまま持ち、落ち着いた所で乾き具合を確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 紙を挟んだまま持ち落ち着いて乾き具合を確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-10.translation: Understood. For now I'll carry it with the sheet inserted and check how dry it is once I'm somewhere settled.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will keep the paper inserted while carrying and check drying in a calm place.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: どうぞお気を付けて。濡れたままの書いた部分をこすらずお持ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-14-001-SHARED-11.translation: Take care. Please carry it without rubbing the writing while it is still wet.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 見学のことで何かご質問はありますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-01.translation: Do you have any questions about your visit?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 学校の宿題に使いたいです。写真を撮れる展示なら、説明文を全部そのまま提出してもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 撮影許可があれば説明文を全て宿題へ使えるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-02.translation: I'd like to use it for school homework. If an exhibit permits photos, may I submit its whole explanation text exactly as it is?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether photography permission allows using the entire explanation for homework.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 撮影できる対象と、写真や文の利用方法は別に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-03.translation: Please check permitted photo subjects separately from how photos and text may be used.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 写真の案内だけで、文章を全部使ってよいとは決まらないんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 撮影案内と文章利用の条件は別だと確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-04.translation: So photography guidance alone doesn't establish that I may use all the text.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that photography guidance and text-use conditions are separate.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。宿題の条件は学校にも確認し、展示の撮影表示をご覧ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Check the homework conditions with your school too, and read the exhibit photography signs.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 自分で分かったことをメモしたいです。撮れない所で、手帳に短く感想を書くことはできますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 撮影不可の場所でも短い自分の感想をメモできるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to note what I understood myself. Where photos aren't allowed, may I write short personal impressions in my notebook?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may note short personal impressions even in no-photography areas.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路を空けて、ご自身の見学メモを取っていただけます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-07.translation: You may take your own visit notes while keeping the passage clear.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。人が写り込む場所は避けて、撮れる展示だけを撮り、メモと分けて残します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 他人を写さず許可対象の写真と見学メモを分けると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I'll avoid places where people would appear, photograph only permitted exhibits and keep photos separate from notes.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will avoid photographing others and separate permitted exhibit photos from visit notes.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: ほかのお客様の見学にも配慮してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please be considerate of other visitors too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 宿題には自分の説明を書き、参考に見た展示だと分かるようにします。撮影した写真の扱いは学校へ確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 自分の説明と参照元を示し写真利用は学校へ確認すると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll write my own explanation for the homework and make clear which exhibit I referred to. I'll check photo use with my school.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will provide your own explanation and reference source and check photo use with school.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。撮影の表示を守り、周りの方に配慮してご見学ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-15-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Follow the photography signs and be considerate of others during your visit.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 池のそばでお困りですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you having trouble by the pond?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 帽子が水に落ちました。浅そうなので、靴を脱いで取りに入ってもよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 池に落ちた帽子を浅そうなので取りに入れるか聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-02.translation: My hat fell in the water. It looks shallow; may I take my shoes off and go in to get it?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can enter the seemingly shallow pond to retrieve your fallen hat.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 中へ入らず、落ちた場所を教えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-03.translation: Don't enter; please tell me where it fell.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 岸のこの石の近くです。風で飛びました。自分も入ろうとしましたが、まだ岸にいます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 落ちた場所と風の経緯を示しまだ岸にいると伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-04.translation: Near this rock on the bank. The wind blew it away. I was going to enter too, but I'm still on the bank.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show the fall location and explain the wind in Japanese, saying you are still on the bank.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 見える深さだけで判断せず、そのままお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-05.translation: Don't judge from the apparent depth; please wait where you are.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 分かりました。枝で引き寄せることもせず、係の方へ場所を伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 自分で水や枝を使わず係員へ知らせると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-06.translation: Understood. I won't try pulling it closer with a branch either; I'll tell staff the location.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not enter the water or use a branch yourself and will notify staff.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 帽子の特徴は分かりますか。

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 紺色で白いひもがあります。水の上に見えますが、流れる先は分かりません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 帽子の特徴と今見える位置を答え流先は不明と区別する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-08.translation: Navy with a white cord. I can see it on the water, but don't know where it will drift.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Give the hat's features and current visible position in Japanese, distinguishing its unknown drift destination.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 位置と特徴を担当へ伝え、対応できるか確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll tell the person responsible its location and features and check whether they can respond.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 回収できると決めて待つのではなく、まず案内を受けます。子どもも岸から離して一緒に待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 回収を確約と思わず子どもと岸を離れて案内を待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-10.translation: I won't wait assuming retrieval is guaranteed; I'll hear the guidance first. I'll also move my child away from the bank and wait together.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will not assume guaranteed retrieval and will wait away from the bank with your child for guidance.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。池から離れてお待ちください。状況を担当へ知らせます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-16-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Please wait away from the pond. I'll tell staff the situation.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: お待たせしています。一杯はできていますが、もう一杯は少しお時間がかかります。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-01.translation: Thank you for waiting. One drink is ready, but the other will take a little longer.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 会社へ急ぎたいので、できた一杯を先にもらえますか。残りは友人が取りに来たいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 出来た一杯を先に受取り残りは同行者へ任せられるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-02.translation: I need to hurry to work. Could I take the ready drink first? My friend would like to collect the remaining one.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you can collect the ready drink first and leave the other for your companion.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 受け取りを分けるご希望ですね。お二人の分は同じ注文番号ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-03.translation: You'd like separate collections. Are both drinks under the same order number?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: はい。この番号で二杯です。先に一杯渡してもらって、全部渡した記録にならないよう確認したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 同一番号で二杯だと示し全受取扱いにならないよう頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-04.translation: Yes, two drinks under this number. I'd like to check that handing over one first won't be recorded as everything collected.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Show that two drinks share one number and ask in Japanese not to mark the full order collected.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 残る一杯と、受け取り方法を確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's confirm the remaining drink and collection method.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人には番号だけを送ればよいですか。私が受け取った方はホットの方だとも伝えます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者へ番号と自分が受取る飲物を伝える方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-06.translation: Is sending my friend just the number enough? I'll also tell them that the one I collected is the hot drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to tell your companion the number and which drink you are collecting.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 番号と、未受取の一杯の内容をお伝えください。こちらでも記録します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please give them the number and details of the uncollected drink. We'll record it here too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 友人にはアイスの一杯が残っていると知らせます。来るまで置いておけるかも確認をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 未受取はアイス一杯と特定し保持できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-08.translation: I'll tell my friend one iced drink remains. Could you also check whether it can be kept until they arrive?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Identify the uncollected item as one iced drink and ask in Japanese whether it can be held.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: お待ちいただける時間と、受取の扱いを担当に確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-09.translation: I'll check with the person responsible how long it may wait and how collection will be handled.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 案内が分かってから友人に来る時間を伝えます。今はホット一杯だけを受け取ったと確かめます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 保持案内後に同行者へ時間を知らせ現在の受取数を確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-10.translation: Once I know the guidance, I'll tell my friend when to come. For now I'll confirm I've collected only one hot drink.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will tell your companion when to arrive after the holding guidance and confirm the number collected now.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。一杯の受取と残る一杯を分けて、確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-17-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll distinguish the collected drink from the remaining one, check and explain.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご家族でご利用ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-01.translation: Are you visiting as a family?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: はい。娘と別々に入るので、出たら私の脱衣所で待ってもらおうと思いました。そこでは合流できませんか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 別々の入浴後に自分の脱衣所で家族と合流できるか尋ねる。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-02.translation: Yes. My daughter and I will bathe separately, so I thought I'd have her wait in my changing room afterwards. Can't we meet there?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese whether you may meet family in your changing room after bathing separately.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: お二人が共通で利用する待合せ場所をご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-03.translation: We'll show you a common waiting place both of you can use.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 娘の所へ私が入り直すのでもなく、二人とも外の休憩場所へ出るんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 互いの脱衣所へ入らず共通の場所で合流すると確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-04.translation: So I won't go back into my daughter's area either; we'll both come out to the common rest area.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Confirm in Japanese that you will meet in a common area without entering each other's changing rooms.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: はい。この共通の休憩場所で、ご利用後にお待ちください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-05.translation: Yes. Please wait in this shared rest area after use.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: どちらが先に出ても分かるよう、時計の下を待合せ場所にしてよいですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 先に出た人が待つ具体的な目印を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-06.translation: So either person can find it if they finish first, may we make beneath the clock our meeting place?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese about a specific landmark where the first person out can wait.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 通路をふさがないこちらの席をご利用ください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-07.translation: Please use this seat here, which doesn't block the passage.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: この席ですね。携帯はロッカーにしまうので、入っている間に返信をもらう前提にはしません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 案内席を復唱し入浴中の携帯返信を前提にしないと言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-08.translation: This seat, then. Our phones will be in lockers, so I won't count on getting replies while we're bathing.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Repeat the indicated seat and say in Japanese that you will not assume phone replies during bathing.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 入る前に、お二人で場所を確かめてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-09.translation: Please confirm the place together before entering.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 娘とこの席を見てから入ります。先に出た方がここで待ち、見つからない時は受付へ相談します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 入浴前に場所を共有し不在時は受付へ相談する方針を伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll look at this seat with my daughter before we go in. Whoever finishes first will wait here, and if we can't find each other, we'll ask reception.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will share the location before bathing and consult reception if the other person is missing.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。共通の場所を確認し、困った時は受付へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-18-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Check the shared location, and if you have trouble, speak to reception.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: ご予約の確認をいたします。お名前をお願いします。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-01.translation: I'll check your reservation. May I have your name?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: グエンです。確認に二名とあるので、私が今日、友人が明日、一泊ずつ使えると思いました。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 二名の予約を二人が別の日に使う二泊と思ったと説明する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-02.translation: Nguyen. Since the confirmation says two people, I thought I could use one night today and my friend one tomorrow.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Explain in Japanese that you mistook a two-person booking for two nights usable by two people on different days.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: 二名は泊数ではなく、ご利用人数です。予約の日付を一緒に確認しましょう。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-03.translation: Two people refers to occupancy, not nights. Let's check the booking dates together.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 今日から明日までの一泊ですね。同じ日に二人で泊まる内容だったんですね。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 予約日と人数を確認し同日一泊二名だと訂正する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-04.translation: One night from today to tomorrow, then. So the booking was for two people staying the same night.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Check the booking dates and occupancy and correct your understanding in Japanese to two people for the same single night.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: この予約内容はこちらで確認します。明日の別の宿泊をご希望ですか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-05.translation: We'll check this booking here. Would you like another separate stay tomorrow?

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 友人は明日来ます。勝手に予約を分けず、今日の人数と明日の別の予約ができるか相談したいです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 同行者の翌日到着を伝え現在人数変更と別予約を相談する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-06.translation: My friend arrives tomorrow. Rather than split the booking myself, I'd like to ask about today's occupancy and whether a separate booking tomorrow is possible.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that your companion arrives tomorrow and ask about changing current occupancy and making a separate booking.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: 空室と変更条件を担当が確認します。いま元の予約は取消していません。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-07.translation: Staff will check availability and change conditions. The original booking has not been cancelled now.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: ありがとうございます。二名の一泊を二日分に使えると友人へ言ったので、まだ確認中だと訂正します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 同行者へ二日使えるという未確認の説明を訂正すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-08.translation: Thank you. I told my friend that one night for two people could be used across two days, so I'll correct that and say it's still being checked.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will correct your unconfirmed claim to your companion about using the booking for two days.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: 変更した場合の料金も確認してご案内します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-09.translation: We'll check and explain any charges if changed too.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 料金と部屋の確認を受けてから決めます。元の予約と新しい希望を別々に書いてもらえますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 変更料金と空室確認後に決め元予約と希望を分けて記録してほしいと頼む。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll decide after confirmation of the price and room. Could you write the original booking and new request separately?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese to decide after change-price and availability checks and to record the original booking separately from your request.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。現在の一泊二名と、明日の宿泊希望を分けて確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-19-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. We'll check the current one night for two people separately from tomorrow's requested stay.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-01.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-01.sourceJa: 今日は東側の区画で補助をお願いします。担当表はこちらです。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-01.translation: Please assist in the eastern section today. Here is the assignment chart.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-02.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-02.sourceJa: 昨日の西側を片付けようと思っていました。今日は場所が変わったのですね。何から始めますか。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-02.hintJa: 昨日の西側と今日の東側の違いを示し最初の作業を聞く。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-02.translation: I was planning to tidy up yesterday's western section. The place has changed today, then. What should I start with?
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-02.hintTranslation: Distinguish yesterday's west from today's east and ask in Japanese about the first task.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-03.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-03.sourceJa: まず東側の担当者へ声をかけて、作業の順番を確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-03.translation: First speak to the person responsible in the east and check the work order.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-04.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-04.sourceJa: 分かりました。西側に残った道具もありますが、先に自分で取りに戻るのは待ちます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-04.hintJa: 旧区画の道具を自己判断で取りに戻らず待つと伝える。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-04.translation: Understood. Some tools remain in the west, but I'll wait rather than go back to get them on my own first.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-04.hintTranslation: Say in Japanese that you will wait rather than independently return for tools in the old section.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-05.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-05.sourceJa: 道具の移動は担当へ知らせてからにしましょう。東側は車両の通路に近い所です。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-05.translation: Let's notify the person responsible before moving tools. The east side is close to the vehicle route.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-06.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-06.sourceJa: 車両が来る道を横切る必要があるか確認したいです。昨日の安全な経路と同じだとは思わず聞きます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-06.hintJa: 今日の車両経路を昨日と同一視せず通行方法を確認する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-06.translation: I'd like to check whether I need to cross the road vehicles use. I'll ask rather than assume it's the same safe route as yesterday.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-06.hintTranslation: Ask in Japanese how to proceed without treating today's vehicle route as identical to yesterday's.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-07.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-07.sourceJa: この指定の歩行経路を使ってください。通行時は誘導員の案内に従ってください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-07.translation: Use this designated pedestrian route. Follow the guide's directions when passing.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-08.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-08.sourceJa: 地図のこちらですね。東側の担当者に合流してから、必要な道具と運び方を確認します。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-08.hintJa: 指定経路を示し担当合流後に必要道具と運搬を確認すると言う。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-08.translation: This route on the map, correct? After meeting the east-side person responsible, I'll check the necessary tools and how to transport them.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-08.hintTranslation: Indicate the designated route and say in Japanese that you will check needed tools and transport after meeting the person responsible.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-09.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-09.sourceJa: はい。分からない作業は、始める前に確認してください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-09.translation: Yes. Check any unfamiliar work before starting.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-10.speaker: PLAYER
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-10.sourceJa: 東側へ指定の経路で行き、昨日の続きとして勝手に進めません。担当と道具の扱いを確認してから始めます。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-10.hintJa: 旧作業を勝手に続けず担当と道具確認後に開始すると報告する。日本語で伝えてください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-10.translation: I'll take the designated route east and won't continue yesterday's work on my own. I'll check the responsible person and tool handling before beginning.
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-10.hintTranslation: Report in Japanese that you will not independently continue the old work and will begin after checking responsibility and tools.

DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-11.speaker: NPC
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-11.sourceJa: 承知しました。担当表と経路を確認して、東側の係へお声がけください。
DLG-SC-LOC-012-20-001-SHARED-11.translation: Understood. Check the assignment chart and route, and speak to the east-side staff.
